status: contract_only; no fixture geometry modelled, fabricated or measured
release_gate: A fixture model is accepted (RR-CAD-05/06) only when every clause is evaluable, each evaluable clause is met by the regenerated geometry within a declared tolerance, and the physical commissioning checks named under verification are recorded. Pending clauses are filled by inspection or owner decision in the register, never here.

clauses.requirement: Inspected effective free length from clamp datum to load line equals the registered mast_length
clauses.verification: Inspect effective free length after clamp installation

clauses.requirement: Ideal cantilever stiffness of the registered specimen; the scale every fixture term is compared against
clauses.note: Model quantity (E is a model_assumption). Recompute from the as-built stiffness once inspected; not an as-built value.

clauses.requirement: Load-point fixture translational stiffness >= fixture_stiffness_ratio_min x specimen stiffness on EACH axis at the actual force line
clauses.verification: Physical commissioning at the load point; a rigid CAD solid is not stiffness evidence. Ratio does not bound root rotation.

clauses.requirement: Independent tip AND root indicator stations, each at or below indicator_resolution_limit, with fixed reference supports and recorded measurement directions
clauses.verification: Instrument IDs and calibration records in the campaign evidence

clauses.requirement: Ideal-beam tip displacement across the protocol force range, for count-resolution planning only
clauses.note: Planning scale; the frozen gate is on the fitted slope, not pointwise counts.

clauses.requirement: Root rotation is observed with two spatially separated root stations over a measured baseline; a single root translation channel cannot observe rotation

release_requirement.root_rotation_station_spacing: Choose measured baseline and propagate angular uncertainty
release_requirement.actual_load_height: Measure load line relative to clamp datum

clauses.formula: angular_std_urad = differential_quantization_std_um / root_rotation_station_spacing_mm * 1e3; tip_equivalent_um = angular_std_urad * actual_load_height_mm * 1e-3
clauses.note: Quantization-only planning terms assume independent uniform rounding; calibration, hysteresis and drift are still required in the filled error budget.

clauses.requirement: Force line height above the clamp datum, measured; equals the lever used in every stiffness and rotation term

release_requirement.actual_load_height: Measure load line relative to clamp datum

clauses.requirement: Root clamp engagement length and fastener configuration reproduce the actual mast root restraint

release_requirement.clamp_engagement: Owner supplies actual clamp geometry and fastener configuration

clauses.requirement: Deck-side clamp bolt pattern measured on the mating datum; full deck CAD not required

release_requirement.clamp_bolt_pitch: Measure deck-side mating datum; full deck CAD not required

clauses.requirement: Sensor bracket bolt pattern and optical-centre offset from the exact purchased sensor revision and bracket drawing

release_requirement.lidar_bracket_bolt_pitch: Identify exact sensor and bracket drawing
release_requirement.optical_center_offset: Measure actual optical-center offset from tube tip

clauses.requirement: Tip assembly mass used by the reference model equals the weighed body + bracket + moving cable; no heat-sink plate or hardware added silently
clauses.verification: Sum body plus bracket and cable assumptions; not weighed assembly
clauses.note: Register value is a summed allowance (model_assumption), not a weighed assembly.

evidence_note: Derived values are model quantities from design_choice/model_assumption rows; passing a geometry comparison against them means the fixture model matches the intended design, not that an as-built fixture is stiff enough or that the campaign is ready.
